name: Seeing Theory (Brown University)
goodFor: Interactive visualisations of basic probability and statistics.

evidence.quote: Feel free to use Seeing Theory for educational purposes, but we ask that you do not use the visualizations for commerical use.
Seeing Theory is no longer being mantained.

notes: The project's GitHub README asks that the visualisations not be used commercially, while the repository's LICENSE file is Apache 2.0, so its own pages disagree; Ceder has paid plans, so an app only links to it. The site itself (seeing-theory.brown.edu) couldn't be reached from this container and its terms weren't read; the README links an older address on students.brown.edu. The README says (2019 update) the project is no longer maintained and the site stays hosted by Brown University.
